name: Solenne Spire Executive Biosync Power Suit
description: This is not clothing. This is architecture. The Solenne Spire Executive Biosync Power Suit is a bespoke commission requiring three biometric fittings, two consultation sessions, and a minimum eight-week lead time. The jacket is a double-breasted cut in deep anthracite biosync wool — a living-fiber fabric that actively monitors the wearer's core temperature and adjusts thermal output within ±0.5 degrees, fed by a paper-thin thermofilm layer sewn between the outer shell and the silk-analog lining. The posture-enhance inner structure — a network of memory-shape microfilament boning — subtly shifts when the wearer slouches, providing passive correction without discomfort. The trousers are perfectly tapered in matching biosync wool, with gene-compatible construction throughout: a discreet tail-channel runs the full length of the back waistband and terminates in a self-sealing vent at the trouser seat, accommodating tails up to 60cm in diameter without visible alteration to the exterior silhouette. A bespoke horn-loop collar system is available as a fitting option on the jacket. The shirt is a privacy-weave silk-analog in pale silver with a standing collar — the privacy-fabric lining blocks passive BCI signal harvesting, meaning no ambient scanner in the building reads anything off the wearer's neural hardware unless they choose to allow it. Footwear is a hand-lasted welt-sewn Oxford in genuine heritage leather with a biosync insole that adjusts arch support in real time. No visible branding anywhere.
functionality: Active thermal regulation ±0.5°C via thermofilm layer, passive posture correction via memory-shape boning, gene-compatible tail-channel and optional horn-loop collar, privacy-weave shirt blocks passive BCI signal harvesting, biosync insole for real-time arch support, RFID-null exterior shell, no visible branding
what_it_says: Power dresses down. At Tier 5, the suit doesn't signal status through visible luxury markers — it signals it through the total absence of effort. No logos. No augmentation displays. No visible technology. The suit simply makes the wearer look more composed, more present, and more correct than everyone else in the room, and it does this invisibly. The person wearing this does not need you to know how much it cost.
worn_by: geneware-modified executives who require discreet accommodation
manufacturer: Solenne Atelier — Bespoke Spire Division (commission only)
price_range: Φ 18,000–Φ 45,000+ (bespoke commission, price varies by fitting complexity and gene-compatible options)
story_hooks: A character obtains a stolen Solenne biosync suit — it fits well enough, but the biometric thermofilm is calibrated to the original owner, and the suit's thermal behavior subtly misfires under stress, marking the impersonator to anyone who knows what to look for.

The privacy-weave shirt is blocking more than passive BCI harvesting — it's also blocking an emergency locator signal that Spire security embedded in all executive-tier garments after a kidnapping incident; the wearer doesn't know the signal exists, and neither does their security detail.

During a high-stakes boardroom confrontation, a character notices that the opposing executive's posture is unnaturally perfect — they recognize the Solenne biosync correction system and understand that the executive is more nervous than they appear, because the suit is working overtime.

physical_description.visual_profile: A commanding silhouette of geometric precision and understated power. The double-breasted jacket sits sharp across broad shoulders with a subtle architectural cant; the trousers fall in clean, unbroken lines. The overall impression is one of controlled authority—corporate throne-maker aesthetic. Worn by someone augmented or genetically modified, the suit seamlessly accommodates their biology without betraying it.
physical_description.fit: Impeccably tailored to the individual body. The jacket has a refined but structured drape; the trousers are perfectly tapered from hip to ankle. Posture-enhancing microfilament creates an almost imperceptible corrective tension—the wearer stands straighter without conscious effort. The tail-channel accommodation is completely invisible unless the wearer is augmented with genetic or biological modifications.
physical_description.primary_material: Deep anthracite biosync wool as primary outer shell. Silk-analog privacy-weave for the shirt in pale silver. Genuine heritage leather for hand-lasted welted Oxfords. Paper-thin thermofilm interlining. Memory-shape microfilament boning throughout.
physical_description.texture: The biosync wool has a dense, almost liquid softness—cool to the touch but warm-responsive. The privacy-weave shirt feels subtly textured, almost imperceptibly woven. The leather Oxfords show patina-ready grain. Overall tactility whispers rather than shouts: premium without ostentation.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep anthracite (almost charcoal-black) as dominant color. Pale silver shirt provides stark, clinical contrast at the collar and cuffs. The natural leather footwear in warm cognac-brown grounds the ensemble. No patterns, no variation—absolute chromatic discipline.
physical_description.closures: Invisible. Double-breasted jacket likely uses magnetic snap integration beneath fabric. Trousers use a concealed friction-fit waistband with gene-compatible vent closure. Shirt uses standard covered buttons in matte finish. Oxfords feature minimalist lacing.
distinctive_features: Active thermofilm layer regulating core temperature ±0.5 degrees
Posture-enhance microfilament boning providing passive spinal correction
Gene-compatible tail-channel running full back waistband length with self-sealing vent
Optional horn-loop collar system for augmented wearers
Privacy-weave silk-analog blocking BCI signal harvesting
Biosync insole providing real-time arch support adjustment
Zero visible branding anywhere on the garment
Custom biometric fitting architecture unique to wearer
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—commission-only, three-fitting minimum, eight-week lead time. The price point exists only in negotiation. Solenne Atelier, Bespoke Spire Division.
physical_description.cultural_context: This is worn by those who have moved beyond status-signaling into pure functional elegance. Corporate executives with actual power, not title. Those augmented enough to need accommodation but wealthy enough to hide it. The wearer is saying: 'I am above the need to display wealth. My body may not be entirely human, but my authority is absolute.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine, even after wear. Biosync wool self-maintains. The leather ages into character rather than degradation. This is a garment that improves with careful use—never wrinkled, never tired-looking.

Anthracite double-breasted jacket with pale silver privacy-weave shirt, perfectly tapered matching trousers, cognac leather welted Oxfords. Studio lighting with cool blue-white accent on the jacket, warm amber on the shoes. Minimal dark background, architectural shadows emphasizing the suit's geometric lines. Close detail shots of the invisible seams, the magnetic closures, the thermofilm shimmer if light catches it right.
